method.pricing: EXECUTABLE ONLY — long spot at ask, short future at bid. Midpoint is never used for a shown carry.
method.invariant: executableBasisPct <= indicativeBasisPct, enforced per row; violations dropped, not clamped.
method.capacity: Walked order-book ladder only (capacitySource "book" + a present ladder). Open interest is never capacity.
method.fees: Per-leg provenance. OFFICIAL_PUBLIC_API where the venue publishes fees unauthenticated (Deribit only, plus Bybit delivery); PROJECT_CONSTANT otherwise. feeVerified requires every leg official.
method.ranking: Net annualized carry after fees. Options without measured capacity always sort last.
method.riskFree: Delta against 4%/yr risk-free, shown signed — negative deltas are displayed, not hidden.

limitations: Only Deribit publishes fees on a public endpoint; OKX, Binance and Bybit maker/taker are auth-gated. Cross-venue fee ranking is therefore directional, not proven.
Both spot legs price on Binance, so no two-venue route is fully fee-verified.
Single-venue routes are surfaced but never ranked: no walked ladder exists for any venue-native spot book.
Base-tier fees are the worst case; a real account may pay materially less.

options.priceBasis: EXECUTABLE (long spot @ ask, short future @ bid)
options.feeNote: Spot legs price on Binance, whose fee schedule is auth-gated — not publicly verifiable. Total is directional, not proven.
options.routeNote: Spot leg prices on Binance; future on the listed venue. Capital sits on two exchanges, no cross-margin between legs.

singleVenueAlternative.note: Bybit lists spot alongside the dated future, so a single-account carry is possible, but its spot fees are auth-gated and we hold no walked ladder for its spot book. Neither fee nor capacity can be stated honestly.

options.priceBasis: EXECUTABLE (long spot @ ask, short future @ bid)
options.feeNote: Spot legs price on Binance, whose fee schedule is auth-gated — not publicly verifiable. Total is directional, not proven.
options.coinMarginedNote: Coin-settled: the carry is locked in coin, not USD.
options.routeNote: Spot leg prices on Binance; future on the listed venue. Capital sits on two exchanges, no cross-margin between legs.

singleVenueAlternative.note: Fees fully sourced from Deribit public endpoints and materially cheaper than the two-venue route, but CAPACITY IS UNKNOWN: no walked ladder exists for Deribit spot, whose book is far thinner than Binance. Not ranked against measured routes until that book is walked.

best.why: Highest net carry after fees among 2 venue(s) with measured book capacity.
